set.rappels: Rappel the NW Chimney back to the moat on double ropes, building anchors from slung horns, chockstones and your own gear: there is no fixed hardware, and what tat exists is poor. No count is published; plan on several rappels, then reverse the CJ Couloir.
set.rappel_count_note: No party has published a rappel count or station list for this descent, so none is shown. Expect to build every anchor yourself in the NW Chimney, bring doubles for full-length rappels, and carry cord to leave behind.
